or_apm.title: Analysis Procedures Manual v2, Chapter 4 Safety

hsm.title: Highway Safety Manual
hsm.decided: critical rate against the corridor's own sites (user, #34 item 7, docs/03); used in every state until that state's own screening is built

crash_costs.missing: ODOT prices fatal + serious (KA) and moderate + minor (BC) together, by highway type and urban/rural (TSAP 2021 Table 2, 2019 dollars; research 2026-11-07); CrashIQ can't yet tell a corridor's highway type and urban/rural

statewide_rates.missing: ODOT publishes intersection rates per MEV (APM Exhibit 4-1, 2003-2007 data) and state-highway segment rates per MVMT (Crash Rate Table II, 2020-2024; research 2026-11-07), but CrashIQ has no Oregon traffic counts and doesn't compare with them yet

screening.state_method: SPIS (0.1-mile, 3 years, frequency + rate + severity) and the HSM critical crash rate at P = 1.645 (APM Ch. 4; research 2026-11-07)

min_years.missing: APM recommends 5 years, the Safety Investigation Manual 3 (research 2026-11-07, pages not re-checked)

spf_calibration.missing: APM Exhibit 4-11 publishes HSM calibration factors; not loaded (no SPF engine)
